page.title: Enchantment Reckoner
page.heading: Enchantment reckoner
page.pick_item_first: Pick an item first, good sir
page.theme_dark: Turn to the dark of night
page.theme_light: Turn to the light of day
page.reset_help: Clear thy setup and settings, and see the first screen again (saved setups abide)
page.language_confidence: The code's hue showeth how sure the rendering is: green, high trust; yellow, middling trust; red, poor (an unchecked draft).
page.feedback_title_suggestion: What would you like to see?
page.feedback_ask_correction: What is wrong, and what should it say or do?
page.feedback_ask_bug: What happened, and what did you expect?
page.feedback_ack: I understand that my feedback, including my setup and anything I type in it (such as a rename), will be public on GitHub
page.feedback_no_account: No GitHub account? Use Copy report instead.
page.feedback_translation_note: Thank you for helping! Pick the language and make the change right in GitHub's editor: when you save, it's sent to us for review.
page.feedback_tier_3: This translation has been checked, but we'd still love to hear if something is off.
page.feedback_tier_2: This translation is fairly reliable, and a second pair of eyes would help.
page.feedback_tier_1: This one is still a draft, so your corrections would mean a lot.

bedrock.label: Bedrock
bedrock.help: Bedrock Edition: each enchantment costs only the levels it adds, Impaling is cheaper, and there is no Railing Edge

wanted.intro: Find the cheapest anvil order to put enchanted tomes upon an item. Choose the item and its enchantments, then follow the steps, good sir.
wanted.example: Try an example: Mermaid's Ease boots
wanted.graph_hint: {nodes} enchantments, {edges} clashes. Hover or focus one to see its clashes; click to choose it.
wanted.expand_groups_label: Unfold all groups and boxes in Enchantments
wanted.collapse_groups_label: Fold all groups and boxes in Enchantments
wanted.legend_one: In a Choose one, pick one option, or none. Picking another replaces it.
wanted.legend_side: The sides may not go together: take from one side only. Each side keepeth its own rule.
wanted.legend_part: The parts never clash: take from any of them, each by its own rule.
wanted.legend_any: In a Choose any, the options go together: choose as many as thou wilt.
wanted.legend_stray: Also clasheth with a thing in another side or part (hover it to see what).
wanted.legend_badges: Badges that number the sides and parts of a group.
wanted.takes_none: A {item} taketh no enchantments in {edition} Edition, forsooth.
wanted.saved_save_help: Lay up this item and its enchantments as a preset of thine own
wanted.saved_unusable: {name} cannot be used here: its item is not offered
wanted.saved_exists: This is already saved as “{name}”, forsooth.
wanted.saved_name_taken: Thou hast already a preset called “{name}” for {item}, forsooth.
wanted.cost_meter_help: Anvil levels for the best order with the tomes below

cost_help.one: About {levels} level to add this from a tome, before any prior work
cost_help.other: About {levels} levels to add this from a tome, before any prior work

wanted.short_help: Thy tomes and items in section 3 cannot reach the level chosen here.

books.automatic_help: One tome for each enchantment chosen in the Enchantments section
books.custom_help: List thine own tomes and items, with copies and prior work

prior_work_cost.one: Its prior work addeth {levels} level to each merge it is in.
prior_work_cost.other: Its prior work addeth {levels} levels to each merge it is in.

books.prior_work_none: Never used upon an anvil, so no extra cost.
books.edit_line: Change enchantments, or drag onto another entry to move it
books.on_other_entry: Doth clash with {name} upon another entry
books.coverage_label: Enchantments chosen in the Enchantments section, reached or not
books.cover_toggle: Show or hide the enchantments already reached
books.chip_drag_hint: Drag upon an entry to put it there
books.duplicate_help: Add a copy of this entry, to change it

copies_edit.one: Copies: {count}. Use − and +, or scroll over it
copies_edit.other: Copies: {count}. Use − and +, or scroll over it

books.type_placeholder: Write a tome: prot 4, mending, x3
books.type_label: Add one tome by writing its enchantments, with commas between them; add x3 for three copies
books.reorder_help: Drag to reorder, or focus and press the up and down arrow keys
books.copies_help: How many identical copies of this thou hast, e.g. a stack of the same tome
books.prior_work_help: How many times this hath already been used upon an anvil. Each use maketh later merges more costly.
books.alert_auto_note: One tome for each chosen enchantment; thy custom list shall be dropped.
books.unwanted_help: Not chosen in Enchantments. It will still go upon the item and cost levels.

ranking.rank_by: The best order is picked by the four tiles below: the order with the lowest value in the first tile wins, and the next tiles break ties. Drag a tile, or use its ‹ › arrows, to change which counteth most.
ranking.rank_help_label: How the best order is chosen

xp.label: XP
xp.help: Total XP points spent. Higher levels cost more XP each.

max_step.label: Max level
max_step.help: Most levels spent upon one anvil use

prior_work.label: Prior work
prior_work.help: Prior work upon the result: the lower it is, the cheaper later anvil use upon it will be

ranking.show_motion_help: Off, nothing upon the page slideth, fadeth or moveth (glints have their own switch). It is kept in this browser; the page also followeth thy device's reduced-motion setting.
ranking.glints_reduced: Off: thy device asketh for reduced motion
ranking.glints_help: The slow purple sheen over enchanted items and chosen enchantments. It keepeth running when Show animations is off; turn it off here.
ranking.descriptions_help: What each enchantment doth, under its name in Choose Enchantments: only whilst thou point at it (or tab to it), or ever. It is kept in this browser.
ranking.rules_reset_help: Level limit 39 and no conflicts, as in the game
ranking.allow_conflicts_help: For mods that let conflicting enchantments go together
ranking.mods_help: Addeth a mod's enchantments to the lists. The numbers come from the mod's own files and may differ in thy version.
ranking.level_limit_help: No anvil use may cost more levels than this
ranking.level_limit_label: Most levels allowed per anvil use
ranking.rename_help: Type a name to rename the item in the last step (+1 level). Leave it blank for no rename.
ranking.rename_label: New name for the finished item
ranking.your_level_help: Thy XP level now, to see what thou hast left after each step
ranking.set_needed_help: Set thy level to exactly what the steps not yet ticked need
ranking.use_level_help: Follow thy level through the steps: the level before and after each one

results.slow_search: {count} entries: this may take a while.
results.too_many_different: Too many different entries. Repeated tomes are fine, but at most 20 different ones.
results.no_valid_order: No valid order: these cannot be combined.
results.no_valid_order_within: No valid order within the {limit}-level limit.
results.limit_lowered_hint: Every order hath a step above thy limit.
results.too_expensive_hint: Every order hath a step of 40 levels or more, which the game refuseth (“Too Costly!”). Tomes with less prior work, or fewer enchantments per tome, may help.
results.break_step: Without a limit the best order hath {steps} steps, and step {number} costeth {levels} levels: over thy limit of {limit}.
results.break_beyond: Even without a limit, step {number} costeth {levels} levels. The game stoppeth at {game}.
results.extra_help: These came along upon thy tomes or items. They are included in the cost.
results.round_help: These steps need not each other's results, so do them in any order.
results.step_done_help: Tick off steps as thou doest them. Kept in this browser.
results.anvil_safe: A new anvil will not break
results.anvil_wear_help: Each anvil use hath a 12% chance to damage the anvil. A new anvil breaketh on its third damage.
results.compact_help: Show only the slots, with the details when thou hoverest

step_instruction.one: Put {left} in the left slot and {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costeth {levels} level.
step_instruction.other: Put {left} in the left slot and {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costeth {levels} levels.

results.step_rename_note: Type “{name}” in the name box first.

checkpoint.one: Gain {count} level first: thou needest level {level}
checkpoint.other: Gain {count} levels first: thou needest level {level}

results.copy_checklist_help: Copy the steps as a checklist, with a checkbox for each
results.copy_steps_help: Copy the steps as text, e.g. to paste in a chat
results.print_help: Print the steps, or save them as a PDF
results.share_help: Copy the steps or the link, or print them
results.copy_link_help: Copy a link to this setup, with the steps thou hast ticked

text_totals.one: {levels} level in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step
text_totals.other: {levels} levels in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step

results.worker_failed: The calculator failed to load. Check the browser console for details.
results.metadata_failed: Couldn't load the enchantment data. Serve this folder over HTTP instead of opening the file directly.

descriptions.aqua_affinity: Mine at normal speed beneath the waves
descriptions.bane_of_arthropods: Extra harm to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites
descriptions.binding_curse: Cannot be taken off once donned
descriptions.blast_protection: Less harm and knockback from explosions
descriptions.breach: Blows ignore some of the foe's armour
descriptions.channeling: Thrown in a tempest, it calls lightning down upon the foe
descriptions.density: Smash blows do more harm the farther thou fallest
descriptions.fire_protection: Less harm from fire, and burning ceaseth sooner
descriptions.fortune: More drops from ores and crops
descriptions.frost_walker: Turns water to ice as thou walkest upon it
descriptions.impaling: Extra harm to creatures of the sea
descriptions.infinity: Shooting useth not up arrows (thou needest one)
descriptions.loyalty: The trident returneth after it is thrown
descriptions.luck_of_the_sea: Better chance of treasure when fishing
descriptions.mending: Experience thou gatherest mendeth the item
descriptions.projectile_protection: Less harm from arrows and other missiles
descriptions.riptide: Thrown in water or rain, it launcheth thee with it
descriptions.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves, like ores and glass
descriptions.soul_speed: Walk faster upon soul sand and soul soil
descriptions.thorns: Hurts the foes and players that strike thee
descriptions.wind_burst: Smash blows bounce thee back up into the air
